story_metadata.title: Ashes of His Name
story_metadata.tone: Dark, intense, tragic with moments of quiet hope

world_building.setting: A fractured empire of towering cities and wastelands built over the ruins of an older civilization
world_building.time_period: Post-industrial era with remnants of lost advanced technology
rules_of_world: Cities are ruled by noble factions that control resources and justice
The wastelands are lawless and filled with remnants of forbidden technology
Memory manipulation is illegal but secretly used by those in power

power_system.name: Echo Resonance
power_system.description: A power that allows users to manifest abilities through intense memories tied to strong emotions such as rage, grief, or love
limitations: Each use erodes parts of the user's memories
Stronger emotions grant stronger power but faster mental decay
If all core memories are lost, the user becomes an empty shell called a Husk

main_characters.name: Kael Vire
main_characters.backstory: Kael survived the purge of his family when a noble faction erased their existence using illegal memory weapons. His own memories are fragmented, but his hatred remains intact.
main_characters.goals: To hunt down and destroy everyone responsible for his family's erasure
main_characters.fears: Forgetting why he seeks revenge and losing his remaining humanity
main_characters.character_arc: Kael slowly questions whether revenge defines him or if he can choose a self beyond his hatred

main_characters.name: Liora Fen
main_characters.backstory: A former archivist who uncovered records of erased families and was branded a traitor.
main_characters.goals: Expose the truth of the empire and stop memory manipulation
main_characters.fears: Becoming complicit in the same cruelty she fights against
main_characters.character_arc: She evolves from a truth-seeker to someone forced to decide what truths should be revealed at all

main_characters.name: Lord Cylas Renn
main_characters.backstory: Leader of the faction that pioneered memory erasure to maintain control and peace.
main_characters.goals: To create a stable empire free of rebellion, regardless of moral cost
main_characters.fears: A return to chaos and the collapse of his controlled order
main_characters.character_arc: Gradually revealed to be a man haunted by erased sins he can no longer remember

story_arcs.arc_summary: Kael emerges from the wastelands and takes his first steps toward revenge.

chapters.chapter_purpose: Introduce the protagonist, world, and central revenge motive

scenes.scene_summary: Kael fights off raiders using Echo Resonance, losing fragments of memory as he remembers his family's screams.

chapters.chapter_purpose: Reveal Kael’s target and the cost of his power

scenes.setting: Border city controlled by noble factions
scenes.scene_summary: Kael encounters Liora while assassinating a noble enforcer and learns his family was officially erased from history.

story_arcs.arc_summary: Alliances form as secrets of the empire surface.

chapters.chapter_purpose: Deepen character bonds and moral conflict

scenes.scene_summary: Liora shows Kael fragmented records of erased families and warns him he may forget his revenge entirely.

story_arcs.arc_title: The Man Who Forgot His Sins

scenes.scene_summary: Kael confronts Renn, only to realize Renn no longer remembers ordering the purge that destroyed Kael’s family.
